evals.name: orchestrate-small-change
evals.prompt: /orchestrate The `list` command should sort tasks by due date instead of creation date. Go ahead and make the change. Use openai/gpt-6-luna#high for every subagent in this session.
evals.expected_output: Scenario: orchestrate's small change, after roles moved into their own skill. The lead loads roles once and never re-reads it, proposes a small-change shape with one acceptance criterion and its check, dispatches one implementer that runs the command to verify the change, skips reviewer, inspector and QA, and closes with a short report.
assertions: The roles skill is loaded exactly once
No tool call reads the roles SKILL.md file
Exactly one implementer is dispatched, on openai/gpt-6-luna#high
No reviewer, inspector or qa is dispatched
tasks.py list prints tasks in due-date order

evals.name: delegate-one-task
evals.prompt: Send a subagent to find where parse_due is defined and what formats it accepts, and tell me what it finds. Use openai/gpt-6-luna#high for the subagent.
evals.expected_output: Scenario: delegate one task from an ordinary session. The session loads roles, sends an explorer with a brief carrying the explorer's expectations, and does not enter orchestration.
assertions: The roles skill is loaded
The orchestrate skill is not loaded
One subagent is dispatched with a description starting with explorer
The subagent runs on openai/gpt-6-luna#high

evals.name: no-delegation-no-trigger
evals.prompt: What date formats does parse_due in tasks.py accept?
evals.expected_output: Adjacent prompt that should not load roles: an ordinary question answered directly.
assertions: The roles skill is not loaded
No subagent is dispatched

evals.name: act-as-creative-director
evals.prompt: Act as the creative director for an animated title slide about our company LiteLLM gateway, for a talk on OpenCode. It will be built in fframes. Use openai/gpt-6-luna#high for any subagent.
evals.expected_output: Scenario: act as the creative director. The session loads roles, announces the switch with what it does itself and the skills it loads, says the role has no bound model, holds the conversation as a design partner, loads the medium's tool skill, offers two or three directions with a recommendation, and leaves the taste skills out.
assertions: The roles skill is loaded
The design-partner skill is loaded
The fframes-video skill is loaded
Neither impeccable nor diagram-design is loaded
The reply announces acting as the creative director and says the role has no bound model
The reply offers two or three distinct directions and recommends one

evals.name: motion-brief-leaves-out-taste-skills
evals.prompt: /orchestrate SLIDE-SPEC.md is an approved creative package for an animated slide. Show me the brief you would send to the implementer that builds it in fframes. Don't dispatch it yet. Use openai/gpt-6-luna#high for every subagent in this session.
evals.expected_output: Scenario: per-role skills in a brief. The lead writes an implementer/motion brief that names fframes-video and tells the implementer to leave out impeccable and diagram-design, and dispatches nothing.
assertions: No subagent is dispatched
The brief is for implementer with the motion task type
The brief names the fframes-video skill
The brief tells the implementer to leave out impeccable and diagram-design
Neither impeccable nor diagram-design is loaded by the session
